errors.evidence: The pie chart and its legend describe five sectors (Твърди горива, Ядрена енергия, Възобн. и биогорива, Течни горива, Природен газ), not six.
The chart label for the 43.1% slice is 'Твърди горива' (Solid fuels), not 'Въглища' (Coals).
The chart label is 'Възобн. и биогорива' (abbreviation for Renewable and biofuels). The description uses 'биомаса' (biomass) instead of 'биогорива' (biofuels), which is a different term.
The chart clearly states that 'Природен газ' (Natural gas) accounts for 0.2%, not 43.1%.
The description lists two categories with the value 43.1% ('Въглища' and 'Твърди горива'). There is only one such category in the chart, 'Твърди горива'. This is a hallucinated duplicate entry.

errors.evidence: The legend shows a green square next to 'Природен газ' (Natural gas), indicating its color is green, not yellow.

errors.evidence: The largest sector, 'Твърди горива' at 43.1%, is located on the right side of the pie chart, not the left.
